title: the first NET SCAN is the baseline; later scans report only strangers

clauses.text: the first NET SCAN is the baseline; later scans report only strangers as one grouped row and one toast

steps.do: Run NET SCAN on a fresh install, then plug in a new device and scan again.
steps.expect: The first scan raises no new-device notes; the second raises one grouped row and one toast for the stranger.
